summary: On/off form toggle with a slotted label and optional supporting text; use for settings that take effect immediately.

usage.text: The required attribute is satisfied only while the switch is on.
There is no indeterminate state; use violet-checkbox when a mixed state is needed.

a11y.text: The inner input has role switch and is labelled by the slotted text. Content in the supporting slot is linked as its description.
